candidate.paper: Memento: Fine-tuning LLM Agents without Fine-tuning LLMs

w_o_cbr_definition.detail: Section 5.3 explicitly states that Memento (w/o CBR) keeps episodic memory disabled, so it is intended to isolate the extra gain from case-based reasoning.

table4_values.metric_context: DeepResearcher continual-learning curve as reported by the paper

paper_interpretation.detail: The paper says increased-iteration accuracy suggests memory-based approaches can enhance agents and explains convergence by Case-Bank saturation (~3k training data, fewer unseen/potentially failing cases later). That explanation is directly applicable to memory-enabled arms but does not by itself identify the cause of the w/o-CBR arm's +5.82 pp rise because that arm is explicitly memory-disabled.

paper_era_repository.detail: At commit f1aa7e3b... on the v2 paper date, the recursive tree contains the basic planner/executor client, tools, figures and README but no released paper experiment harness, per-iteration dataset manifest, Case-Bank construction/evaluation loop, or parametric/non-parametric CBR implementation. The README still lists 'Add Case Bank Reasoning' as TODO. client/agent.py is an interactive single-query planner/executor and resets shared_history at the start of process_query(); it does not implement a five-iteration DeepResearcher experiment operator.

release_chronology.detail: The current official README dates no-parametric CBR inference release to 2025-08-30 and parametric CBR inference release to 2025-10-05, both after arXiv v2 (2025-08-25). Therefore later code cannot be assumed to be the exact Table-4 paper protocol without explicit version correspondence.

unresolved_protocol_fields.inter_iteration_operator_for_w_o_CBR: not specified in inspected paper-era public primary artifacts
unresolved_protocol_fields.seed_or_randomization_manifest: not specified in arXiv v2 text or paper-era repository inspected
unresolved_protocol_fields.per_iteration_raw_outputs: not released in paper-era repository inspected
unresolved_protocol_fields.aggregation_uncertainty_or_multi_seed_va: not reported for Table 4 in inspected v2 text

supported: At each reported iteration, both CBR variants score above w/o CBR in Table 4.
The reported same-iteration arm differences are compatible with a CBR contribution under the paper's experiment protocol.
not_supported: Attributing the shared upward five-iteration slope specifically to episodic memory or Case-Bank continual learning.
Interpreting the w/o-CBR +5.82 pp rise as evidence of memory learning when episodic memory is disabled.
Inferring a specific retry, resampling, cumulative scoring, or data-order operator from the published curves.
Using later CBR implementation revisions as proof of the exact Aug-2025 Table-4 protocol without explicit provenance linkage.
causal_scope.recommended_downstream_wording: Table 4 verifies same-iteration performance separation between CBR and memory-disabled w/o-CBR arms, but the common upward iteration trend is causally unidentified because the public paper-era artifacts do not specify the w/o-CBR inter-iteration operator, seeds/order, retry/cumulative accounting, or raw per-iteration manifests.

secondary_reproducibility_signal.source: official-repository issue #36 (2026-02-01; user report, not author-verified primary evidence)
secondary_reproducibility_signal.detail: A reproducer reports that the released default dummy memory is insufficient to match a Musique paper result and requests the paper case-bank trajectories. This supports an artifact-completeness concern but is not used as primary evidence for Table-4 correctness or falsity.

contradiction_assessment.worker_claim: control slope protocol unknown; shared upward curve cannot identify memory-specific continual learning
contradiction_assessment.material_correction: No contradiction to the numeric Table-4 values was found. The defect is causal/auditability scope: the paper's memory-based interpretation of the shared iteration curve exceeds what the publicly specified control operator identifies.

unresolved_high_value: Obtain the exact paper-era Table-4 experiment harness or author clarification specifying the w/o-CBR inter-iteration operator, seeds/order, retry policy, cumulative/best-of accounting and aggregation.
Obtain per-iteration raw predictions/manifests for all three arms and reproduce the curve under pinned models/data/tool snapshots.
Use a matched frozen held-out transfer or explicitly stationary repeated-control protocol to separate memory learning from repeated-attempt/data-order effects.
